scope: 当前游戏HTTP协议、字段语义和Round/Delivery/Step状态机；不包含Java实现

identity.warning: 平台启动记录、平台g_id和原生gid是不同命名空间；不得把其他平台记录的g_id=57映射到本游戏。

transport.requestEncoding: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset behavior follows encodeURIComponent with spaces encoded as +

encryption.evidence: bundle Http.encodeFormData/Http.post sends plain form data; captured provider requests and JSON responses match; no encrypt/decrypt transform exists in the provider HTTP helper
encryption.secretHandling: t/token values remain redacted in human-readable artifacts

virtualHeaderMapping.description: GameApi callers pass header-shaped state, but Http.post copies these values into form parameters and does not emit them as HTTP headers.

transport.successRule: HTTP 2xx plus JSON code numerically/string-equal to 200 resolves data; other codes reject; HTTP/non-JSON errors become HTTP<status>.

endpointSequence.purpose: obtain native launch URL containing /57/, gid=57, l, sip and redacted session values

endpointSequence.requestFieldEvidence: Platform.getSessionArgm keeps recognized launch fields; Http.post maps game-id to gid
endpointSequence.purpose: exchange launch session for provider player state and provider token
initialize bet, paytable, currency and last-result state
paid step and every continuation/free step use the same endpoint
only scheduled when auth ping.enable is truthy; captured auth had enable=0, seconds=0

fieldSemantics.ba: 本Step扣注额；付费起点为bl*bs，逐步免费Spin为0；7个聚合免费终局样本在同一付费响应中为0.5
fieldSemantics.pb: 本Step结算后的玩家余额；客户端每次响应直接刷新PlayerData.Coins
fieldSemantics.rskl: 长度15、按卷轴分成3组、每组5个原始符号/BLANK的reel-major编码
fieldSemantics.wmkl: 中奖映射；键0..4为5条固定线，特殊键5表示SC触发奖，不是第6条线；值为用于spl查表的结果代码
fieldSemantics.rwa: 当前阶段累计中奖额；免费阶段样本从首个免费Step重新累计，不包含付费触发Step的SC奖
fieldSemantics.fsn: 本Round授予的免费Spin总数；普通为0，确认的免费模式为10
fieldSemantics.nfsc: 已交付/当前免费Spin序号；触发为0，逐步免费为1..10
fieldSemantics.ss: 服务端步骤/序列结束标志；不能单独当完整Round终止标志，因为免费触发Step可为1但fsn!=nfsc
fieldSemantics.rpx: 当前Step中奖倍率；普通/触发为1，免费Spin为3
fieldSemantics.gt: 1=付费普通或付费触发Step，2=免费Step/聚合免费终局（仅对已捕获值作此解释）
fieldSemantics.small_game_type: 0=普通结果，2=FREE_SPINS相关结果（仅对已捕获值作此解释）

spinResponse.payoutEquation: wa = sum(spl[wmkl[lineKey]] * bl * bs * rpx) for observed winning entries; SC key 5 follows the same equation with spl.SC=7

boardAndWinModel.rawEncodingWarning: rskl不是普通3x3数组。每卷轴5个交替符号/BLANK，客户端移除BLANK后追加到动画卷轴；规则允许每卷轴2或3个BLANK。

roundDeliveryStepStateMachine.upstreamIdentifiers: Spin响应未观察到roundId/deliveryId/stepId；captures中的roundId和stepIndex是采集器合成字段

deliveryContractForJava.generation: 中奖及特殊模式一次生成完整Round；fixtures不得作为运行时结果源
deliveryContractForJava.delivery: 每次请求只交付pendingRound的nextStep；不得为活动Round临时重生结果
deliveryContractForJava.prohibitedInference: 不得把合成roundId/stepIndex输出成声称来自原站的字段

historyStateMachine.observedTransition: enable history -> log-list -> select ll[0].tis=2093578569416081408 -> first log-view -> detail prefab issues second log-view with the same transfer_id -> concatenate bsl then fsl -> render detail -> close sets CurId=null and dispatches HISTORY_DETAIL_BACK -> existing list opacity restored to 255
historyStateMachine.termination: detail close/back returns to existing list state; list pagination stops when response.end is truthy
historyStateMachine.adjacentEvidence: captures/57-Crazy-777/history-adjacent-evidence.json; sequence 1 log-list, sequences 2-3 log-view, followed by observed HISTORY_DETAIL_BACK state
